purpose: Outcome-independent GIFT 3.2 island-area matching for the held-out Ogasawara raw weighted-network capacity test.
lock_rule: Lock only one uniquely best GIFT island entity with an exact normalized alias match, or a unique alias substring match when no exact normalized match exists. Area must be finite and positive. No network metric, ABM output, invasion context, or desired direction may affect the match.
claim_boundary: This file freezes geography aliases only. It does not assert a capacity effect and does not alter the four source-native Ogasawara weighted networks.
